traits.zh: 有四个露台可供朋友小聚
traits.en: Has four terraces for small groups to gather

traits.zh: 招牌饮品为苹果肉桂拿铁
traits.en: Signature drink is apple cinnamon latte

traits.zh: 整面临街玻璃，采光充足
traits.en: Full-height street-facing glass, ample natural light

traits.zh: 店内及通道绘有涂鸦，呼应园区艺术
traits.en: Interior and entryway feature graffiti reflecting M50's art vibe

energy.zh: 露台与临街设计带来一定人流
energy.en: Terraces and street frontage draw some foot traffic

linger.zh: 露台和艺术氛围适合久坐
linger.en: Terraces and artistic setting invite lingering

focus.zh: 无办公设备，专注度不高
focus.en: No work setup, low focus potential

adventure.zh: 精品豆与特色饮品具一定创新性
adventure.en: Specialty beans and unique drink offer moderate novelty
